Perhaps the most widely used Imperial military-grade munitions, Frag munitions are most commonly found in grenade and missile form. Both explode in showers of shrapnel and other lacertaing metals, making them ideal for anti-infantry duties. Almost every warrior in the Imperium, from Militarum troopers to elite Space Marines, carries frag grenades to aid in assaulting positions, with grenade launchers providing longer range infantry suppression. Frag missiles are the more powerful version, with a greater range to soften up distant positions such as heavy weapon teams.

Frag grenades have a large radius, and deal decent damage.

Repurposed industrial devices, demolition charges are most often heavy packs or containers filled with shaped explosives that must be placed against their target rather than thrown. They use a variety of delays, from standard det chords to electronic timers, to ensure the user is far enough away when they detonate.

A Demolition Charge always comes with a linked @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.4e2Jhd8jwmKiszzB]{Remote Detonator}.

Perhaps the most widely used Imperial military-grade munitions, Frag munitions are most commonly found in grenade and missile form. Both explode in showers of shrapnel and other lacertaing metals, making them ideal for anti-infantry duties. Almost every warrior in the Imperium, from Militarum troopers to elite Space Marines, carries frag grenades to aid in assaulting positions, with grenade launchers providing longer range infantry suppression. Frag missiles are the more powerful version, with a greater range to soften up distant positions such as heavy weapon teams.

Frag grenades have a large radius, and deal decent damage.

These powerful but unwieldy explosives are generally affixed to stationary targets via magnetic adhesion. They use technology similar to Melta weapons but concentrate their effects into a shaped charge; this makes them exceptionally lethal against even the strongest of armour plating and tank hulls.

Melta bombs deal very high damage and have the @UUID[JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#rend-(rating)]{Rend} Trait, but only affect the target they are attached to.

Ostensibly designed for mining operations, blasting charges are most often bulky tubes filled with compact explosives. Though they are designed to be linked together and detonated from a distance, they are nonetheless favoured as improvised explosives by gangs and dissidents on industrial worlds, where knowledge of their operation is widespread and are found in bulk. Blasting charges are powerful but have a limited radius.

These grenades employ the same constricting filament gel as webbers, but are rigged to explode in a wide area. Their effect is similar; the strands expand through the air, ensnaring anyone and anything in a nearly impenetrable net that pulls tighter the more they struggle, perfect for capturing bounties and other prey.

When a Web Grenade hits a Zone, all creatures in that Zone must make a Hard (−20) Reflexes Test or suffer the @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#restrained]{Restrained} (Minor) Condition. Escaping the webbing requires a Challenging (+0) Extended Athletics (Might) Test requiring a total of 10 SL, with one Test allowed per turn.

Fire bombs are ancient explosives, dating back to the unknowable past when Humans first discovered that certain liquids were flammable. Promethium or other exotic substances are placed in fragile containers, fitted with burning cloth or electronic igniters, and hurled. The container bursts on impact, spreading flaming liquid across a wide area. Due to their ease of construction, crude bombs are found on almost all Imperial worlds, and the flames they spread are often the first signs of an uprising.

You can make a Ranged Attack to target an enemy with a Fire Bomb. The target is set @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#ablaze]{Ablaze}. Alternatively, you can target a Zone with a Fire Bomb. A Fire Bombs turns a Zone it hits into a @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#hazard]{Minor Hazard} for three rounds. This duration can be extended or shortened depending on the amount of flammable material in the Zone, such as arid forests or rain-slicked spires.

Krak grenades and missiles are found throughout the Imperium war machine. They are designed for armour penetration and overwhelm most personal protective gear with ease. Krak rounds also excel at blowing apart bulkheads, vehicle hulls, and fortifications, leaving those inside exposed and vulnerable.

Krak munitions have high damage and the @UUID[JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#penetrating-(rating)]{Penetrating} Trait, but a limited radius.

These stunning grenades detonate with searing bursts of light that blinds and disorients those not wearing adequate eye protection. These explosives are so bright that they can reflect off matte plasteel and concrete, blinding those who turn their backs from the explosion itself.

When a Photon Flash Grenade hits a Zone, all creatures in that Zone must make a Hard (−20) Reflexes Test or suffer the @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#blinded]{Blinded} Condition for three rounds.

These grenades release clouds of noxious gases, enough to bring the sturdiest rioter gasping to their knees. Enforcers often use them to disperse mobs and clear taverns of suspects, consequently many outlaws carry filtration masks to counter their debilitating effects.

When a Choke Grenade hits a Zone, all creatures in that Zone must make a Hard (−20) Fortitude (Endurance) Test or suffer the @UUID[JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#stunned]{Stunned} (Minor) Condition for three rounds. Additionally, anyone who enters or starts their turn in that Zone for the next three rounds must make the same Test. This duration can be extended or shortened depending on the ventilation, such as enclosed spaces or strong winds.

Krak grenades and missiles are found throughout the Imperium war machine. They are designed for armour penetration and overwhelm most personal protective gear with ease. Krak rounds also excel at blowing apart bulkheads, vehicle hulls, and fortifications, leaving those inside exposed and vulnerable.

Krak munitions have high damage and the @UUID[JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#penetrating-(rating)]{Penetrating} Trait, but a limited radius.

Smoke grenades release plumes of thick gas that obscure the vision of most species (especially Humans). They don't block infrared, sound, or other means of detection, and so are easily mitigated by prepared combatants.

Smoke grenades make the target Zone @UUID[JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#obscured]{Heavily Obscured} for three rounds. This duration can be extended or shortened depending on the ventilation, such as enclosed spaces or strong winds.

Large Bolt weapons utilised by the Ordo Malleus, Psycannons fire massive bolts imbued with negative psychic energy, their truesilver tip inscribed with wards and anti-daemonic sigils. Each bolt devastates psykers and daemons, combining the destructive potential of typical bolt weapons with sanctified and psychically charged energy. A gravitic stabiliser supports the weapon — as large as a Heavy Bolter — making it far easier to bear into combat.

A Psycannon is a Bolt Weapon designed to cut through psykers, daemons, and other warp entities. In addition to the normal bonuses provided by its Psybolt ammunition, ranged attacks made with this weapon ignore any armour provided by psychic powers, daemonic Traits, or other effects. The benefits of the weapon’s gravitic stabiliser are already included in its profile — it would otherwise suffer from the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#heavy-(rating)]{Heavy} Trait.

A Psycannon can be loaded with ordinary Heavy Bolter ammunition (900 Solars) but many would see such an act as sacrilege and misuse of such a precious weapon.

A fusion of shotgun and crossbow, the Purgatus Crossbow is an improvement over the ancient witch-hunting crossbows. Designed to launch specialised bolt ammunition, commonly in the form of stakes.

The Purgatus Crossbow, like many crossbows, are favoured and iconic weapons among Ordo Hereticus acolytes. While the basic bolts of the Crossbow are significant enough to kill most heretics, they can also be fitted with specialised @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.BbyZqcWs3HbrAO3Y.JournalEntryPage.m5vFbshZfLkQsVMC]{Stake ammunition}.
@UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.BbyZqcWs3HbrAO3Y.JournalEntryPage.3Dfxlo5D4J9BxkTD#shuriken-weapons]{Shuriken Weapons}

A specialised combi-weapon, combining the ferocity of a Boltgun with a single-shot stake crossbow armature, which can be fitted with a variety of specialised stake rounds. While the Boltgun element easily tears common foes asunder, the potent stakes fired from the crossbow armature vary in effects. However, they all effectively thwart the foul warp magics and energies of psykers and daemons.

The Condemnor Boltgun is an iconic weapon of the Ordo Hereticus. It has two firing profiles, as noted in the Ranged Weapons Table. The Stake Crossbow attached can be fitted with specialised @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.BbyZqcWs3HbrAO3Y.JournalEntryPage.m5vFbshZfLkQsVMC]{Stake ammunition} and gains additional effects from them.

Thought to be created from technology discovered on a Ghost World, these small, grenade-shaped objects are directly attached to their targets. When attached, they send pulses of energy through the victim and into the brain, wreaking havoc on their motor functions and leaving them unable to act. The effect is temporary, and the Brain Mine burns out within seconds, but it is long enough to leave an enemy vulnerable.

A character armed with an Empyrean Brain Mine can attempt to plant it, waiting for an enemy to enter a Zone where it automatically triggers. The Brain Mine attempts to latch onto the triggering creature, who can make a Difficult (−10) Reflex (Dodge) Test to avoid it. On a fail, the Mine latches onto the target, and they are @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#stunned]{Stunned} for 1d5 Rounds.

Alternatively, a character can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.xf46pBDy93sT0ZDl#grapple]{Grapple} a foe and attach the Brain Mine to them. Once Restrained through the Grapple, the target must make a Difficult (−10) Reflex (Dodge) Test to avoid it. On a fail, the Mine latches onto the target, and they are @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#stunned]{Stunned} for 1d5 rounds.
@UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.BbyZqcWs3HbrAO3Y.JournalEntryPage.3Dfxlo5D4J9BxkTD#splinter-weapons]{Splinter Weapons}

Lightweight and elegant, the power weapons of the Aeldari are like, and yet unlike, the power weapons of the Imperium. They typically possess a single cutting edge, so they are keenly balanced and effortless to use. They are sometimes seen as a symbol of status among the Ordo Xenos, looted from defeated xenos, or in more rare cases, a gift from unlikely allies.

Aeldari Power Swords are always @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.ZR29g4RP1E8y9twS#lightweight]{Lightweight} and are so precisely balanced that the wielder can use either their Strength Bonus (StrB) or Agility Bonus (AgB) when dealing damage.

Despite its somewhat primitive nature, the weapon’s design is reliable, and the bolts it fires can punch through armour. Like its more potent variant, the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.items.Item.1dRwi7JTiuXS0vOm]{Purgatus Crossbow}, the weapon’s true strength comes from the specialised ammunition it can use.

It is a favoured weapon of the witch-hunting Ordo Hereticus. Like the Purgatus Crossbow, it can be fitted with specialised @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.BbyZqcWs3HbrAO3Y.JournalEntryPage.m5vFbshZfLkQsVMC]{Stake ammunition}.

A Nemesis weapon is a ritually consecrated artefact of incredible power, its arcane might amplified with silver sigils and the psychic circuitry of a force weapon. These mighty Daemonhammers are said to be the bane of all daemons and the means of their creation is a closely held secret. Some believe that a single blow from a Nemesis weapon can send daemons howling back to the Warp.

Daemons struck by a Nemesis Daemonhammer do not gain the benefit of any bonus die to their Armour value, such as that granted by the Lesser Daemon Trait. Nemesis Daemonhammers are also @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.novkkBnSD2XC7Lgh#force-weapons]{Force Weapons} and @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.novkkBnSD2XC7Lgh#power-weapons]{Power Weapons} combined. When wielded by a character with the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.3GLGsYiH5LiKgYjE]{Psyker} Talent, they deal additional Damage equal to the wielder’s current Warp Charge. This additional Damage is doubled if the target is a daemon. They also have the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#penetrating-(rating)]{Penetrating} Trait while activated. Additionally, when a Nemesis Daemonhammer strikes a daemon, it must make a Challenging (+0) Discipline Test or be utterly unmade.

A specialised combi-weapon, combining the ferocity of a Boltgun with a single-shot stake crossbow armature, which can be fitted with a variety of specialised stake rounds. While the Boltgun element easily tears common foes asunder, the potent stakes fired from the crossbow armature vary in effects. However, they all effectively thwart the foul warp magics and energies of psykers and daemons.

The Condemnor Boltgun is an iconic weapon of the Ordo Hereticus. It has two firing profiles, as noted in the Ranged Weapons Table. The Stake Crossbow attached can be fitted with specialised @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.BbyZqcWs3HbrAO3Y.JournalEntryPage.m5vFbshZfLkQsVMC]{Stake ammunition} and gains additional effects from them.

Despite the antique and ornate appearance of the rifle, it is a complex and tainted weapon, utilising warded arrays and galvanic impellers to fire rending shards of daemonic matter. The weapon is one of concern for puritanical elements of the Inquisition, and there are those among the Adeptus Mechanicus who are eager to recover one to determine how exactly they work.

The Hellrifle is a weapon favoured by Radical Inquisitors of the Ordo Malleus.
@UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.BbyZqcWs3HbrAO3Y.JournalEntryPage.3Dfxlo5D4J9BxkTD#shuriken-weapons]{Shuriken Weapons}
@UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.BbyZqcWs3HbrAO3Y.JournalEntryPage.3Dfxlo5D4J9BxkTD#graviton-weapons]{Graviton Weapons}

A weapon once seen in the hands of the Gland Warriors, guardsmen genetically modified to fight on the horrid fronts of war against Tyranids, the Duelling Glaive is a mighty halberd. Despite its length, the weapon is fairly lightweight, useful for keeping foes at a distance to guard against toxins or corrosive bio-weapons.
@UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.BbyZqcWs3HbrAO3Y.JournalEntryPage.3Dfxlo5D4J9BxkTD#splinter-weapons]{Splinter Weapons}
@UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.BbyZqcWs3HbrAO3Y.JournalEntryPage.3Dfxlo5D4J9BxkTD#pulse-weapons]{Pulse Weapons}

An anointed Warhammer forged from precious metals, its haft engraved with sigils and wards, wrapped in blessed leathers and purity seals. The head of a Daemonhammer is stamped with the blazing symbol of the Inquisition, each smiting blow resounding like a thunderclap, its potent wards sundering the unnatural flesh of daemonic entities.

Daemons struck by a Daemonhammer do not gain the benefit of any bonus die to their Armour value, such as that granted by the Lesser Daemon Trait. A Daemonhammer may also be a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.novkkBnSD2XC7Lgh#power-weapons]{Power Weapon}, gaining the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#penetrating-(rating)]{Penetrating} Trait against all enemies, at a value equal to its base damage bonus. Add 20% to the cost of Power Weapon Daemonhammers.
@UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.BbyZqcWs3HbrAO3Y.JournalEntryPage.3Dfxlo5D4J9BxkTD#kroot-weapons]{Kroot Weapons}

These grenades are scarce and potent weapons, using negatively psi-reactive particles to affect the Immaterium within a given radius, thoroughly weakening psykers and psychic powers within that area. These grenades are available only to the most fervent in the Imperium’s service; the process of creating these grenades relies upon a substance believed to be a byproduct of the process that sustains the Astronomican.

All creatures with a Warp Threshold in the Zone must make a Difficult (−10) Psychic Mastery Test. If they fail they are @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#stunned]{Stunned}. Furthermore, any creature with a Warp Threshold in the Zone has their Warp Threshold reduced by 2. Some creatures might not be perceptive, or disciplined, enough to notice the danger, such as rogue psykers. The effects of the grenade linger for 3 rounds.

A Nemesis weapon is a ritually consecrated artefact of incredible power, its arcane might amplified with silver sigils and the psychic circuitry of a force weapon. These mighty Daemonhammers are said to be the bane of all daemons and the means of their creation is a closely held secret. Some believe that a single blow from a Nemesis weapon can send daemons howling back to the Warp.

Daemons struck by a Nemesis Daemonhammer do not gain the benefit of any bonus die to their Armour value, such as that granted by the Lesser Daemon Trait. Nemesis Daemonhammers are also @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.novkkBnSD2XC7Lgh#force-weapons]{Force Weapons} and @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.novkkBnSD2XC7Lgh#power-weapons]{Power Weapons} combined. When wielded by a character with the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.3GLGsYiH5LiKgYjE]{Psyker} Talent, they deal additional Damage equal to the wielder’s current Warp Charge. This additional Damage is doubled if the target is a daemon. They also have the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#penetrating-(rating)]{Penetrating} Trait while activated. Additionally, when a Nemesis Daemonhammer strikes a daemon, it must make a Challenging (+0) Discipline Test or be utterly unmade.

A psycho-crystalline pistol of obvious xenos design, the Neuro Disruptor is commonly found among the Aeldari, particularly the Harlequin. The weapon appears to be a pointed mass of crystals emerging from a brass housing, lacking any obvious power source, or internal mechanisms. Rather, the weapon appears to use intricate circuitry and lattices to project a wave of particles to disrupt a target’s neural function, with little impingement from armour.

Such weapons are exceedingly rare, and might only be found in the arsenal of Ordo Xenos Inquisitors.

The combat shotguns of the Adeptus Arbites are a cut above others, combining stopping power, intimidating form, and reliability into a brutally effective weapon. Despite appearing as an imposing large-bore shotgun with a smaller ammo capacity than a regular combat shotgun, these weapons have been painstakingly engineered for versatility and use a greater variety of ammunition than normal. The design also inflicts psychological intimidation: from the sound of chambering ammo or the pump action reload, all exaggerated and loud to emphasise a deadly threat.

The Arbites Shotgun can use any Solid Projectile or Shotgun ammunition.
@UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.BbyZqcWs3HbrAO3Y.JournalEntryPage.3Dfxlo5D4J9BxkTD#pulse-weapons]{Pulse Weapons}
@UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.BbyZqcWs3HbrAO3Y.JournalEntryPage.3Dfxlo5D4J9BxkTD#kroot-weapons]{Kroot Weapons}

Controversial weapons, tainted by warp-magic or daemonic essence. They might be weapons once bound with a daemonic entity, now purged, or marked with runes of Chaos. Though less potent than true Daemonblades, Tainted Blades are stained and seething with warp energies, each strike wreaking havoc upon realspace as much as the wielder’s foes.

The Tainted Blade is a Tainted Weapon, used by Radicals and heretics of the Ordo Malleus.

A fearsome and finely-wrought greatsword with a wicked cutting edge of diamond-hard silica glass, the Executioner Greatsword is a weapon of ancient design. It harkens to the oldest days of witch-hunting and executions. The blade’s exacting balance allows the wielder to combine duelling techniques with the ferocity of cleaving strikes.

Executioner Greatswords are always @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.ZR29g4RP1E8y9twS#master-crafted]{Master Crafted}.
@UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.BbyZqcWs3HbrAO3Y.JournalEntryPage.3Dfxlo5D4J9BxkTD#kroot-weapons]{Kroot Weapons}

Swords of common or non-descript designs, double-edged or single, as ornate or commonplace as any other blade across the galaxy. What makes the Blink-Blade special is how they are sheathed and unsheathed. The bearer does not carry a scabbard for such a weapon, as the blade is sheathed and unsheathed seemingly from thin air. These blades are unnaturally sharp, and the ability to make the blade disappear and reappear in a new grip or new orientation makes it difficult to defend against.

The weapon is unusual and exceptionally heretical, therefore not commonly found among the Inquisition; instead acquired from exceedingly Radical sources. The strange nature of the weapons demands a bond with its wielder, an attunement with their mind, to sheathe and unsheathe it. A character that wishes to bond with the weapon can make a series of Difficult (−10) Willpower Tests, one per hour, and when the character has earned 5 SL, they have bonded to the weapon.

The Blink-Blade is impossible to detect when sheathed. The wielder must succeed on a Challenging (+0) Discipline Test to unsheathe the weapon. If they fail, the weapon does not appear. When attacking with the blade, it ignores the Defensive quality of other weapons.

A modified variant of the Heavy Flamer used by many forces within the Imperium, the Incinerator was designed specifically for a secretive branch of the Ordo Malleus. A smaller variant, closer to a conventional Flamer, has been made available to the breadth of the Inquisition and might be found among even the Ministorum. The Incinerator has modified fire projectors, and sanctified fuel containment vessels, to fire psyflame — psychically impregnated promethium that burns azure and purges away psychic protections and daemonic foes.

The Incinerator adds the wielder’s Willpower Bonus (WilB) to the Damage when attacking a daemon or creature with a Warp Threshold.

Difficult to manufacture, Rad Grenades contain deadly, contaminated particles. When the grenade detonates, the particles shower an area, existing for mere moments. Enemies in the area are thoroughly debilitated by potent radioactive effects sapping their strength, while the wielder can quickly charge in without fearing the effects.

When detonated, all creatures in the target Zone must make a Difficult (−10) Fortitude (Endurance) Test. If they fail, they immediately take 5 points of Damage (treated as if they entered a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.hdElQAwiBr5AyoRf.JournalEntryPage.zQYkbNcsJmGintdL#hazard]{Minor Hazard}) and gain the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#fatigued]{Fatigued (Minor)} Condition.
@UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.BbyZqcWs3HbrAO3Y.JournalEntryPage.3Dfxlo5D4J9BxkTD#graviton-weapons]{Graviton Weapons}

A rod forged from a single piece of cold iron, one end is sharpened into a piecing stake, and the other wrought to house a potent power field generator. All along its length, the Power Stake is inscribed with warding runes and sigils. It can function as a simple power weapon, easily piercing armour, but when it strikes a psyker, their impure bodies are set ablaze.

A Power Stake is a weapon commonly found among the Witch Hunters. Functioning as a Power Weapon, when the Power Stake strikes a creature with a Warp Threshold, it inflicts the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#ablaze]{Ablaze }Condition upon them.

The Xenophase Blade is an ancient weapon thought to belong to a long-dead alien dynasty. Although it appears to function as a conventional power weapon, the unusual metals of its composition and the unnatural energy field it produces cleave through armour, force fields, and even metaphysical wards or protections.

Questioning the weapon’s origins, even among the Ordo Xenos, is cause for immediate termination. The Xenophase Blade is a Power Weapon that ignores at least half of the damage reduction from Armour, Force Fields, or any Psychic Power.

These grenades release clouds of invisible, hallucinogenic gas or mind-altering energies to induce short-term psychological episodes. Some effects leave an opponent fumbling around, grasping for delusions only they can see. Other effects induce potent paranoia and delirium, causing them to turn on anyone nearby with rapid ferocity. Despite the short-term effects, these grenades are powerful crowd-control weapons.

Hallucinogen Grenades fill the target Zone with hallucinogenic gas for three rounds. A creature starting their turn in the Zone, or who enters the Zone during their turn, must make a Difficult (−10) Fortitude (Poison) Test or suffer the hallucinogenic effect of the grenade for 1d10 rounds (roll on the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.tables.RollTable.Dy8XzuHFhHpVFytC]{Hallucinogenic Effects} Table). Characters in @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.vhpvfuTVOEHEoM3S]{Power Armour}, other sealed armour, or wearing @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.OdTP4DEK3oGAjMWZ]{Filtration Plugs} or similar equipment can apply their benefits to the Test.

Null Rods are tall, obsidian rods, crackling with anti-psychic energy, nullifying warp power within its area. A blow from a Null Rod can tear apart daemonic essence and trigger a cascade of cataclysmic energy within the mind of a rogue psyker. After battles and engagements, Null Rods must safely discharge their energy, lest they create rifts to the Warp.

A Null Rod is a weapon commonly employed by the Ordo Malleus but not exclusive to them. When a Null Rod strikes a creature with a Warp Threshold, it gains @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#rend-(rating)]{Rend} (X), where the X is the current Warp Charge of the target. Additionally, the first time a Null Rod strikes a psyker each day, the psyker must immediately make a Difficult (−10) Psychic Mastery Test and, upon failure, suffer @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.3mzwixuzgerGUpu1.JournalEntryPage.buydA5mPJln97Qk5#perils-of-the-warp]{Perils of the Warp}.

A scoped pistol with the stopping power of a shotgun, the Shotpistol is used by specialist Adeptus Arbites operatives. Though smaller than the shotguns typically used by members of the Adeptus Arbites, the Shotpistol performs better at range; each shot enough to make a gory mess of criminal and heretic alike.

The Shotpistol can use any Solid Projectile or Shotgun ammunition.

This dagger-like blade can deliver such a potent poison that it can incapacitate foes with a single scratch. Despite its martial features, a wicked curving blade, and slotted blade-catchers above the cross-guard, the weapon is obviously of xenos design. One would be foolish to ask why, or how, such a weapon has fallen in among the wargear of the Ordo Xenos.

The Scythian Venom Talon has the Inflict (@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#bleeding]{Bleeding}) and Inflict (@UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.DjxnvYJajGflu7IY.JournalEntryPage.Tu0sU1bo9eZI6qoe#poisoned]{Poisoned}) Traits.

More potent than regular @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.items.Item.nd8zBS07KVlPzaAd]{Hallucinogen Grenades}, they are filled with a powerful, sweet-swelling nerve gas that induces debilitating visions in the enemy. The psycho-reactive nature of the gas makes it very difficult to filter and protect against.

Psychotroke Grenades fill the target Zone with hallucinogenic gas for five rounds. A creature starting their turn in the Zone, or who enters the Zone during their turn, must make a Very Hard (−30) Fortitude (Endurance) Test or suffer the hallucinogenic effect of the grenade for 1d10 rounds (roll on the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.tables.RollTable.Dy8XzuHFhHpVFytC]{Hallucinogenic Effects} Table). Characters in @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.vhpvfuTVOEHEoM3S]{Power Armour}, other sealed armour, or wearing @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.OdTP4DEK3oGAjMWZ]{Filtration Plugs} or similar equipment can apply their benefits to the Test.

An anointed Warhammer forged from precious metals, its haft engraved with sigils and wards, wrapped in blessed leathers and purity seals. The head of a Daemonhammer is stamped with the blazing symbol of the Inquisition, each smiting blow resounding like a thunderclap, its potent wards sundering the unnatural flesh of daemonic entities.

Daemons struck by a Daemonhammer do not gain the benefit of any bonus die to their Armour value, such as that granted by the Lesser Daemon Trait. A Daemonhammer may also be a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.novkkBnSD2XC7Lgh#power-weapons]{Power Weapon}, gaining the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#penetrating-(rating)]{Penetrating} Trait against all enemies, at a value equal to its base damage bonus. Add 20% to the cost of Power Weapon Daemonhammers.
@UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.BbyZqcWs3HbrAO3Y.JournalEntryPage.3Dfxlo5D4J9BxkTD#kroot-weapons]{Kroot Weapons}

The greatest symbol of the Radical Inquisitor’s philosophy, to use the enemy against the enemy, a Daemonblade is a weapon bound with the essence of a powerful daemonic entity. Though the wardings and bindings placed upon the weapon render it less potent than the weapons wielded by Chaos, they are necessary, lest the wielder be driven insane from the insidious voices within the blade. No Daemonblade is like another, some so specific and potent that they have forged dark reputations.

Daemonblades are weapons wielded by Radical Inquisitors, commonly of the Ordo Malleus. When a Daemonblade is first encountered, the GM should roll, or choose from, both the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.tables.RollTable.t5Da1EFHdmn5gFVv]{Features} and the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.tables.RollTable.Q9AKwGdeu8hJI0aX]{Quirks} columns to describe the powers and nature of the weapon. Once per encounter, when a Daemonblade is drawn, the wielder must make a Challenging (+0) Discipline Test. If they fail, they gain 2 Corruption Points.

Created by members of the Ordo Malleus, a Truename Staff is a length of cold iron etched with warding runes and sigils engraved with the names of nine and ninety powerful Daemons. Consecrated in elaborate rituals of daemon slaying and smiting, they are charged with potent energies, each strike of the weapon capable of sundering any daemonic entity.

Daemons struck by a Truename Staff do not gain the benefit of any bonus die to their Armour value, such as that granted by the Lesser Daemon Trait. Additionally, when a Truename Staff strikes a daemon whose name has been etched upon its haft, that daemon must make a Challenging (+0) Discipline Test or be utterly unmade.

Some Truename Staves can be @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.novkkBnSD2XC7Lgh#force-weapons]{Force Weapons}. When wielded by a character with the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.3GLGsYiH5LiKgYjE]{Psyker} Talent, it deals additional Damage equal to their current Warp Charge. This additional Damage is doubled if the target is a daemon. Add 20% to the cost of Force Weapon Truename Staffs.

A peculiar and rare item, the Handbow is a miniaturised witch-hunting weapon. Though lacking in range, the complex bolt-loading mechanisms allow for a close-range surprise, as even the smaller bolts pack can easily pierce armour and flesh.

The Handbow is a favoured weapon of the Ordo Hereticus. Because of its compact design, it can be easily concealed. Though it may lack the stopping power of larger Crossbow weapons, it can still be fitted with specialised @UUID[Compendium.impmal-inquisition.journals.JournalEntry.BbyZqcWs3HbrAO3Y.JournalEntryPage.m5vFbshZfLkQsVMC]{Stake ammunition} (page 88).

Appearing commonly as jewellery, such as a ring or necklace, Digital Weapons are archaeotech devices capable of delivering a shot with the full strength of a pistol in exceptionally close quarters.

The Jokaero are renowned as the most proficient crafters of Digital Weapons. Exceedingly rare and nigh-impossible to buy, these subtle weapons are highly sought after and often find their way into the hands of Inquisitors.

A Digital Weapon can assume the function of a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.jNxvsLBybPPenmmn]{Laspistol}, @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.CslpAA241OSUVaGF]{Inferno Pistol}, or @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.items.Item.DEguAzj8uwUgVTs8]{Needle Pistol}. The Digital Weapon uses the Damage and any other Trait from the pistol it is modelled after, but its Mag becomes 1, and it gains the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-core.journals.JournalEntry.wqlquQ8Njtd5fb4Y.JournalEntryPage.wsM53RDPPrqwS3Te#subtle]{Subtle} trait. Digital Weapons do not reload and instead recharge after an hour.
